answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism for an agent economy is to require each participant to embed a unique kernel of economic stake that must be locked and risked on every attestation, where failure under peer review burns a portion of that stake. This raises the attacker cost because fabricating many identities demands proportional real capital rather than free accounts, and the stake can be slashed if the opal-quality of proofs fails under gale-force scrutiny from the network.
